name: capability fidelity
wording: a capability reaches the harness at the highest fidelity the harness offers: its own native facility first, then cratylus's own extension to the harness, and prose only where neither is possible; the harness publishes each capability's own explanation, including when to reach for it, to every agent at session start, so no skill restates it, and agents call a capability as a tool rather than follow instructions about it.
reason: The harness already publishes tools with their self-explanation (capability interface); a skill saying when to reach for one duplicates it.
